prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car wreck — the right attorney depends on your case (severity of injuries, liability issues, insurance limits), your priorities (trial experience vs. fast settlement, big-firm resources vs. personal attention), and your location in Houston. I can help you find the best lawyer for your situation. Meanwhile, here’s a practical guide to pick one.

How to choose the best lawyer for your car-wreck case
- Look for specialization and experience
  - Board certification in Personal Injury Trial Law (Texas Board of Legal Specialization) is a strong plus.
  - Substantial experience handling car-accident cases and a proven record of settlements/verdicts for injuries similar to yours.
  - Trial experience and willingness to go to court if the insurer won’t offer fair compensation.
- Reputation and references
  - Peer-recognition lists (Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell) and client reviews (Google, Yelp) are useful signals.
  - Ask for references from recent clients or examples of outcomes in similar cases.
- Resources and team
  - Serious cases often require medical experts, accident reconstruction, investigators — make sure the firm has those resources.
- Communication and fit
  - Prompt, clear communication; you should feel comfortable asking questions.
- Fees and costs
  - Most personal injury lawyers work on contingency (no fee unless you recover). Typical contingency fees range roughly 30–40% depending on when the case is resolved — confirm the exact fee and who advances case costs.
- Local knowledge
  - Experience in Harris County courts and familiarity with local judges, mediators, and opposing counsel can help.

Questions to ask in a free consultation
- How many car-accident cases have you handled? How many went to trial?
- Are you board-certified in personal injury trial law?
- What results have you obtained in cases like mine?
- Who in the firm will handle my case day-to-day?
- What is your fee and how are expenses handled?
- How long will the case likely take? What are the strengths/weaknesses of my case?
- Will you obtain the medical records and police report, or do I need to?
- How will you keep me updated and how often?
- If we can’t settle, are you prepared to take the case to trial?
- Can you provide client references or examples of outcomes?

Useful places to search and verify lawyers
- Texas Board of Legal Specialization (for board certification)
- State Bar of Texas (attorney lookup / disciplinary history)
- Houston Bar Association lawyer referral service
- Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell
- Local Google/Yelp reviews and recent verdict/settlement reports

Urgent note
- Texas statute of limitations for personal injury is generally two years from the crash date — don’t delay in contacting an attorney if you plan to sue.

If you want, I can:
- Prepare a short list of highly regarded Houston personal‑injury lawyers tailored to your ZIP code and case details (tell me your ZIP, the nature/severity of injuries, whether fault is disputed, and whether you prefer a boutique trial firm or a large firm).
- Or give a script/phone questions for initial consultations.
